counterfactual_missing_items: Cluster of differentiation 34 and pan-cytokeratin positivity
decisive_items: Spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels
Loose fibromyxoid stroma without mitotic atypia
Positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the pathological examination findings, including the presence of spindle cells, loose fibromyxoid stroma, and positive immunohistochemistry results. R7 is the runner-up because it also has some support from the laparoscopic and pathological findings, but it lacks the specific immunohistochemistry results that support R3.

rejected.why: Leiomyosarcoma is unlikely due to the benign nature of the lesion and the lack of mitotic atypia.
Uterine Smooth Muscle Tumor of Uncertain Malignant Potential is less likely due to the well-demarcated border and the lack of mitotic atypia.
Leiomyoma of the Uterine Tube is less likely due to the lack of specific support from the pathological examination findings.
Adenomyosis is unlikely due to the lack of support from the final pathology results.
